in_marathi.name: Rameshkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God Rama + Warrior
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rameshkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rameshkumar is a Hindu name, a combination of Rama, the name of the revered Hindu god, and Kumar, which translates to 'young boy'. The name is a tribute to Rama's strength and unwavering loyalty, making it an excellent choice for a boy born into a Hindu family.
